goals.title: Library foundation
goals.summary: The first usable BitLibrary home, navigation, book cards, and reader path are complete.

goals.title: Book discovery
goals.summary: Search, author pages, categories, and browsing now make the library easier to move through.

goals.title: My Library registry
goals.summary: Local-first saved books, saved audio, recent searches, and profile preferences are available.

goals.title: Audiobooks and saved audio
goals.summary: Audio has a discovery page, detail page, custom player, saved state, and progress resume.

goals.title: Search quality
goals.summary: Search now feels calmer, source-aware, paginated, and safer under real typing, spelling mistakes, and mixed source results.

subGoals.title: Wait until the search is clear
Suggest corrections for English and Nepali misspellings
Inline dictionary cards without nested result pages

goals.title: Reader study mode
goals.summary: The reader now works as a study space with bookmarks, highlights, color choices, focus mode, and a stronger tools panel.

goals.title: YoBook curriculum coverage
goals.summary: YoBook is becoming the fastest education source for books, curriculum, chapter PDFs, and chapter-level learning audio.

subGoals.title: Show where each item comes from

goals.title: Curriculum audio player
goals.summary: Curriculum books can now load chapter audio on demand, choose a unit, and play through one shared compact player.

goals.title: Navigation and page polish
goals.summary: Book details now return to the page they came from, long pages have a floating scroll helper, and metadata is more compact.

subGoals.title: Return to the source page from book details
Hide helpers while overlays are open

goals.title: Reader comfort and look
goals.summary: The reader should feel crisp, centered, calm, and usable on mobile and desktop, with side-panel tools and bottom controls staying intentional.

goals.title: Mobile navigation and spacing polish
goals.summary: Mobile readers should get thumb-friendly navigation, cleaner spacing, and simpler mobile-first paths into search, library, reader, and audio.

goals.title: Connected book and audio paths
goals.summary: Books and matching audio should point to each other when they describe the same work or curriculum unit.

goals.title: Library portability
goals.summary: Users should be able to keep, move, and recover their local reading and listening data.

goals.title: Local account/profile management
goals.summary: The local reader profile should grow from a simple name into a proper private account/profile space with preferences, identity details, and management tools.

goals.title: Source quality and usage-right clarity
goals.summary: Every archive-backed item should make source quality, usage rights, license signals, access quality, and readable availability clearer.

subGoals.title: Hide Internet Archive and Open Library entries without readable files

goals.title: Reader read-aloud tools
goals.summary: The reader now supports text-to-speech controls for generated text and PDF pages, with continuous PDF page/spread playback, movable desktop controls, live PDF sentence highlighting, and smooth speed changes.

subGoals.title: Smooth speech speed changes up to 2.5x
Headphone trigger opens, stops, and closes audio controls
Continue reading through PDF pages and two-page spreads

goals.title: Cache management
goals.summary: Version 0.6.0 focuses on a proper cache system so local data is visible, predictable, and safe to clean up.

subGoals.title: Show cache size, age, and source groups
Clear stale API caches without clearing saved library data
Explain what each storage area controls
Add selective cleanup for search, reader, research, and source caches
Protect bookmarks, highlights, saved books, and profile data during cleanup

goals.title: Safe cache cleanup
goals.summary: Cache cleanup should be selective, understandable, and careful enough to avoid deleting important local library data.

subGoals.title: Separate cache cleanup from saved library cleanup
Keep protected reader and profile records safe

goals.title: UI polish
goals.summary: The app should feel cleaner and more consistent across settings, empty states, cards, navigation, reader controls, and library workflows.

subGoals.title: Tighten labels, spacing, and repeated actions
Reduce visual clutter in dense views

goals.title: General feature enhancement pass
goals.summary: Small improvements from real usage should be tracked together so the version improves the whole product, not only one screen.

subGoals.title: Collect small workflow bugs and papercuts
Improve source handling where users hit dead ends
Tighten copy, labels, and route-to-route context
Keep build warnings and performance costs visible

goals.title: Account sync
goals.summary: Sync is intentionally later because local-first library behavior should stay trustworthy first.
